intro_payload.title: मंत्रिपरिषद (Council of Ministers) - केंद्र की असली सत्ता
learning_outcomes: Article 74 - राष्ट्रपति को सहायता व सलाह देने वाली मंत्रिपरिषद

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho ek School Principal bade decisions akele nahi lete - unke saath ek team hoti hai jaise Vice-Principal, Head of Departments, jo mil kar school chalate hain. Kendra sarkar mein bhi aisi hi ek team hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir wo to humne padha tha - PM aur uske Ministers, jaise state mein CM aur uski team hoti hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi yaad hai! Ye poori team - PM ke saath saare Ministers milkar - Constitution mein 'Council of Ministers' (मंत्रिपरिषद) kehlati hai. Aaj hum isi ko poori tarah detail mein padhenge - Union level par.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to jaise state mein CM-led Council thi, waise hi Centre mein PM-led Council hoti hai? Sir ye to pichle chapters se kaafi similar lag raha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi observation! Jaise Article 163 state mein Governor-CM ka rishta batata hai, waise hi Article 74 Kendra mein Rashtrapati aur PM-led Council ka rishta batata hai. Isme likha hai - 'Rashtrapati ko sahayata aur salah dene ke liye ek Council of Ministers hoga, jiska mukhiya Pradhan Mantri hoga'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To yahan bhi wahi pattern hai - Rashtrapati sirf naam ke liye head, asli kaam Council karti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Aur ek zaroori baat - Article 74(1) mein 42nd Amendment (1976) ke baad ye jodi gayi ki Rashtrapati is salah ko 'manne ke liye baadhya' (bound) hai. Baad mein 44th Amendment (1978) ne ek proviso jodi - Rashtrapati ek baar salah ko punarvichar (reconsideration) ke liye wapas bhej sakta hai, lekin agar Council wahi salah dobara de, to use maanna hi padega.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! Matlab Rashtrapati ek baar 'na' bol sakta hai, lekin dusri baar to maanna hi padega - ye to Governor ke bill wale rule jaisa lag raha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi connect kiya! Ab Article 74(2) dekho - ye kehta hai ki Council of Ministers ne Rashtrapati ko kya salah di thi, ye baat kisi bhi court mein poochhi (inquired into) nahi jaa sakti.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab agar Council ne koi galat salah bhi di ho, to court usse janch nahi sakti?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ye ek 'immunity' hai jo salah ki gopniyata (confidentiality) banaye rakhne ke liye di gayi hai, taaki Council khulkar salah de sake bina dar ke ki unki har baat court mein challenge ho jayegi. Lekin dhyan do - final decision (jo action liya gaya) uski judicial review ho sakti hai, sirf 'advice tips' ki nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab salah kya thi ye secret hai, lekin uska result challenge kiya ja sakta hai - ye fine line hai samajhna zaroori hai!

guess_payload.question: Article 74 ke anusar, Rashtrapati ko sahayata aur salah dene wali Council of Ministers ka mukhiya kaun hota hai?
guess_payload.explanation: Article 74(1) ke anusar, Council of Ministers ka mukhiya Pradhan Mantri (PM) hota hai, jo Rashtrapati ko sahayata aur salah deta hai.

quiz_payload.question: 42nd Constitutional Amendment (1976) ne Article 74 mein kya badlav kiya?

options.text: Council of Ministers ka size limit kiya
Rashtrapati ko Council ki salah maanna baadhyakari (binding) banaya
PM ki niyukti ka tarika badla
Council of Ministers ko khatam kar diya

quiz_payload.explanation: 42nd Amendment (1976) ne Article 74(1) mein spasht kiya ki Rashtrapati ko Council of Ministers ki salah maanni hi padegi - ye baadhyakari ban gaya.

quiz_payload.question: Kathan 1: 44th Amendment (1978) ke anusar Rashtrapati ek baar Council ki salah punarvichar ke liye wapas bhej sakta hai. Kathan 2: Agar Council wahi salah dobara bheje, to Rashtrapati use maanne ke liye baadhya hai. Sahi vikalp chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: 44th Amendment ne Article 74(1) mein proviso jodi - Rashtrapati ek baar reconsideration maang sakta hai, lekin dobara wahi salah aane par usse maanna hi padega. Dono kathan sahi hain.

quiz_payload.question: Article 74(2) ke anusar kya baat kisi court mein poochhi (inquired into) nahi jaa sakti?

options.text: Council of Ministers ne Rashtrapati ko kya salah di thi

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 74(2) ke anusar, Council of Ministers ne Rashtrapati ko kya salah di, iski jaanch court mein nahi ki jaa sakti - ye salah ki confidentiality banaye rakhta hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Zabardast shuruaat! Article 74 ka poora concept clear ho gaya. Ab dekhte hain Council of Ministers banti kaise hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Article 75 dekhte hain, jo Council of Ministers ka poora 'ghar' hai - niyukti, shapath, karyakal, sab kuch. Sabse pehla point - Article 75(1) kehta hai PM ki niyukti Rashtrapati karta hai, aur baaki Ministers ki niyukti Rashtrapati PM ki salah par karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to bilkul waisa hi hai jaisa Governor-CM ke case mein tha - CM Governor banata hai, baaki Ministers CM ki salah se!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pattern pakda! Aur PM ki niyukti mein bhi wahi convention follow hoti hai jo humne CM ke case mein padhi thi - Lok Sabha mein bahumat dal ke neta ko hi Rashtrapati PM banata hai. Ye likhit rule nahi, convention hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to Hung Lok Sabha mein Rashtrapati ko bhi discretion use karna padta hoga, jaise Governor karta hai state mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha! Haan, Hung Lok Sabha mein Rashtrapati ko bhi discretion use karna padta hai, exactly jaise Governor state mein karta hai. Ab dekho Minister banne ke liye kya qualification chahiye - iske liye Constitution mein alag se koi list nahi di gayi hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab yahan bhi wahi hai jo CM ke case mein tha - MP jaisi hi qualification chahiye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Minister banne ke liye wahi qualification chahiye jo Parliament ka sadasya (MP) banne ke liye Article 84 mein di gayi hai - Bharat ka nagrik ho, Lok Sabha ke liye 25 saal aur Rajya Sabha ke liye 30 saal umar ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ke liye alag umar? Ye to yaad rakhna padega, do alag numbers hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ab Article 75(4) dekho - pad sambhalne se pehle har Minister ko Rashtrapati shapath dilata hai. Shapath ke do parts hote hain - pad aur gopniyata (secrecy) ki shapath, jinke format Third Schedule mein diye gaye hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye wahi Third Schedule hai na jo CM ke case mein bhi tha? Format same hoga kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi yaad hai! Format bilkul same pattern follow karta hai - Constitution ke prati sacchi shraddha, imandari se kaam, aur bina dar-bhay ke nyay. Sirf 'State' ki jagah 'Union' word aata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab bas ek word ka farak - Union vs State, baaki sab same!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Article 75(2) dekhte hain - Ministers 'Rashtrapati ki khushi tak' (during the pleasure of the President) pad par rahenge. Isliye koi fix term Constitution mein nahi likha, jaise CM/Governor ke case mein bhi tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to bilkul same doctrine hai jo humne dono pichle chapters mein padha! To normal term bhi 5 saal hi hoga, Lok Sabha ke saath?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Practically Council of Ministers 5 saal chalti hai jab tak bahumat rahe (Lok Sabha ke term ke saath), lekin kagaz par 'Rashtrapati ki khushi tak' hai. Yaad rakho - practically Rashtrapati apni marzi se kabhi nahi hatata, sirf PM ki salah par hi hatata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab likha 'Rashtrapati ki khushi' hai, lekin asal mein PM ki khushi chalti hai - ye bahut bada trap hai exam ke liye!

guess_payload.question: Ek vyakti jo Rajya Sabha ka sadasya banna chahta hai, uski minimum umar kitni honi chahiye?
guess_payload.explanation: Article 84 ke anusar Rajya Sabha ke sadasya ke liye minimum umar 30 saal hai, jabki Lok Sabha ke liye 25 saal - ye difference Minister banne ki qualification mein bhi lagu hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: Article 75(1) ke anusar baaki Ministers ki niyukti Rashtrapati kis aadhar par karta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(1) ke anusar, Rashtrapati PM ko niyukt karta hai, aur baaki Ministers ki niyukti PM ki salah par karta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Kathan 1: Ministers ko Rashtrapati pad aur gopniyata ki shapath dilate hain. Kathan 2: Ministers ka koi fix karyakal Constitution mein nahi diya gaya, wo Rashtrapati ki khushi tak pad par rahte hain. Sahi vikalp chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(4) shapath ki baat karta hai (Rashtrapati dilata hai) aur Article 75(2) 'pleasure doctrine' batata hai - dono kathan sahi hain.

quiz_payload.question: Union Minister banne ke liye kaunsi qualification chahiye?

options.text: Wahi qualification jo Parliament ka sadasya (MP) banne ke liye Article 84 mein di gayi hai
Kam se kam 40 saal ki umar

quiz_payload.explanation: Minister banne ke liye Constitution mein alag qualification nahi di gayi - wahi qualification lagu hoti hai jo Article 84 mein MP banne ke liye di gayi hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Bahut badhiya! Pleasure doctrine wala trap ab tumhe pakka yaad hai. Ab dekhte hain koi bina MP bane Minister kaise ban sakta hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab ek interesting rule dekho - Article 75(5). Kya zaroori hai ki Minister banne se pehle koi vyakti Parliament ka sadasya ho? Jawab hai - nahi zaroori nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Arre ye to bilkul wahi rule hai jo humne CM ke case mein padha tha - Article 164(4)!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi yaad kiya! Yahan bhi wahi 6 mahine wala niyam hai - koi bhi vyakti jo Parliament ka sadasya nahi hai, use bhi Minister banaya ja sakta hai, lekin use 6 lagatar mahino ke andar Parliament ke kisi bhi sadan (Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha) ka sadasya banna zaroori hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab agar 6 mahine mein nahi bana to pad chhodna padega, bilkul CM wale rule jaisa!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ek practical example samjho - koi bhi PM ya Minister Rajya Sabha ka sadasya hokar bhi ban sakta hai, sirf Lok Sabha ka hi zaroori nahi. Yaad rakho, CM ke case mein Rajya Sabha allow nahi tha, lekin PM/Union Minister ke case mein Rajya Sabha allow hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Ruko sir, CM Rajya Sabha se nahi ban sakta tha kyunki Rajya Sabha Parliament ka hissa hai, state legislature ka nahi. To PM Rajya Sabha se kaise ban sakta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut achha doubt! PM/Union Minister ko Parliament (Lok Sabha YA Rajya Sabha) ka sadasya hona hai - dono Parliament ke hi ang hain. Lekin CM ko State Legislature (Assembly YA Council) ka sadasya hona hai - Rajya Sabha State Legislature ka hissa nahi hai, isliye wahan allow nahi tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! Ab samajh gaya - matching level zaroori hai! PM ke liye Parliament ka koi bhi sadan chalega, CM ke liye State Legislature ka koi bhi sadan chalega, lekin cross nahi kar sakte!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda ye pattern! Ek aur zaroori baat - agar koi Minister Lok Sabha ka sadasya nahi hai (matlab Rajya Sabha se hai), to use Lok Sabha ki karyavahi (proceedings) mein bolne aur hissa lene ka adhikar hai, Article 88 ke tahat, lekin wo vote nahi de sakta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab wo baat kar sakta hai lekin vote nahi de sakta? Ye to strange hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha! Article 88 dono sadano ke liye ye rule deta hai - koi bhi Minister ya Attorney General kisi bhi sadan mein bol sakta hai, kisi bhi committee mein hissa le sakta hai, jiska wo khud sadasya nahi hai, lekin sirf usi sadan mein vote de sakta hai jiska wo sadasya hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, ye to bahut logical hai - baat karne ka adhikar sabko, lekin vote sirf apne sadan mein!

guess_payload.question: Kya ek vyakti jo Rajya Sabha ka sadasya hai, wo Bharat ka Pradhan Mantri (PM) ban sakta hai?

options.text: Nahi, PM sirf Lok Sabha se ban sakta hai
Haan, PM Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha, dono mein se kisi ka bhi sadasya ho sakta hai
Sirf agar wo pehle Lok Sabha mein rah chuka ho
Ye Constitution mein likha hi nahi hai

guess_payload.explanation: PM sirf Parliament ka sadasya hona chahiye, Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha - dono chalega, kyunki dono hi Parliament ke ang hain. Manmohan Singh iske practical example hain, jo Rajya Sabha se PM the.

quiz_payload.question: Article 75(5) ke anusar, ek non-member Minister ko kitne samay ke andar Parliament ka sadasya banna zaroori hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(5) - non-member Minister ko 6 lagatar mahino ke andar Parliament ke kisi bhi sadan ka sadasya banna zaroori hai, warna pad chala jaata hai.

quiz_payload.question: Kathan 1: Article 88 ke anusar koi Minister kisi bhi sadan mein bol sakta hai chahe wo uska sadasya na ho. Kathan 2: Wo Minister us sadan mein vote bhi de sakta hai jiska wo sadasya nahi hai. Sahi vikalp chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: Kathan 1 sahi hai - Article 88 ke tahat Minister kisi bhi sadan mein bol sakta hai. Kathan 2 galat hai - wo sirf apne sadan mein hi vote de sakta hai, jiska wo asli sadasya hai.

quiz_payload.question: CM aur PM ki Legislature membership ke rule mein kya major difference hai?

options.text: Dono sirf Lower House se ban sakte hain
PM Parliament ke kisi bhi sadan (Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha) se ban sakta hai, CM sirf State Legislature (Assembly/Council) se
Dono kisi bhi sadan se ban sakte hain, koi restriction nahi
CM Rajya Sabha se bhi ban sakta hai

quiz_payload.explanation: PM/Union Minister Parliament ke kisi bhi sadan (Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha) ka sadasya ho sakta hai. CM/State Minister sirf apne rajya ki State Legislature (Assembly ya Council) ka sadasya ho sakta hai - Rajya Sabha se nahi.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Zabardast! PM aur CM ke Legislature wale trap ko tumne solid pakad liya. Ab Council of Ministers ke size aur composition dekhte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Chalo ab Council of Ministers ke size ka ek zaroori niyam dekhte hain - 91st Constitutional Amendment (2003) ne Article 75(1A) joda, jaise humne state ke liye Article 164(1A) padha tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to bilkul same lag raha hai jo hum Council of Ministers state wale chapter mein padh chuke hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha! Article 75(1A) kehta hai - PM samet total Council of Ministers ki sankhya, Lok Sabha ki kul sadasya sankhya (543) ke 15% se zyada nahi ho sakti. Iska matlab maximum ~81 Ministers ho sakte hain (PM samet).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 543 ka 15%... to ye approx 81 hua! Achha, aur state mein minimum 12 ka rule tha, yahan bhi hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut achha sawal! Yahan ek zaroori trap hai - state ke Article 164(1A) mein minimum 12 Ministers ka rule tha, lekin Union ke Article 75(1A) mein sirf maximum limit (15%) di gayi hai, koi minimum number nahi diya gaya!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Matlab Union mein koi minimum nahi hai lekin State mein hai? Ye to exam mein confuse kar dega!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda trap! Ye BPSC ka favorite comparison hai - dono jagah maximum 15% same hai, lekin State mein minimum 12 Ministers ka rule hai, Union mein koi minimum nahi diya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, ye difference note kar leta hoon - 'Minimum sirf State mein, Union mein nahi!'

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Article 75(1B) dekho, jo 91st Amendment ne hi joda - agar koi MP kisi Political Party se Anti-Defection Law (10th Schedule) ke tahat disqualify ho jaata hai, to wo Minister banne ke liye bhi ayogya (disqualified) ho jaata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab agar koi party badalta hai aur Anti-Defection Law se disqualify ho, to wo Minister bhi nahi ban sakta?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ye us purani practice ko rokta hai jaha log dal-badal karke turant Minister ban jaate the. Ye disqualification jab tak Vidhan Sabha/Lok Sabha ka agla chunav na ho ya wo dobara chuna na jaaye, tab tak rehta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab ye sirf state ke liye nahi tha, Union mein bhi wahi anti-defection wala rule lagu hai Ministers ke liye!

guess_payload.question: Lok Sabha mein kul 543 seats hain. Article 75(1A) ke 15% rule ke hisaab se, PM samet maximum kitne Union Ministers ho sakte hain (approx)?
guess_payload.explanation: 543 ka 15% = 81.45, isliye PM samet maximum approx 81 Union Ministers ho sakte hain - koi minimum number specify nahi kiya gaya.

quiz_payload.question: Article 75(1A) ke anusar Council of Ministers ka maximum size kya hai?

options.text: Lok Sabha ki kul sadasya sankhya ka 10%
Lok Sabha ki kul sadasya sankhya ka 15%

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(1A), 91st Amendment (2003) dwara joda gaya, ke anusar PM samet Council of Ministers ki sankhya Lok Sabha ki kul sadasya sankhya ke 15% se zyada nahi ho sakti.

quiz_payload.question: Kathan 1: Union Council of Ministers ke liye koi minimum sankhya Constitution mein nirdharit nahi hai. Kathan 2: State Council of Ministers ke liye minimum 12 Mantri ka pravdhan hai. Sahi vikalp chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: Dono kathan sahi hain - ye Union (Article 75(1A)) aur State (Article 164(1A)) ke beech ka bada difference hai jo BPSC mein bahut poocha jaata hai.

quiz_payload.question: Article 75(1B) ke anusar, kaunsa vyakti Union Minister banne ke liye ayogya (disqualified) ho jaata hai?

options.text: Jo 35 saal se kam umar ka ho
Jo Anti-Defection Law (10th Schedule) ke tahat disqualify ho chuka ho
Jo Rajya Sabha ka sadasya ho

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(1B), 91st Amendment dwara joda gaya, kehta hai ki jo vyakti Anti-Defection Law ke tahat Parliament ya State Legislature ki sadasyata se disqualify ho chuka hai, wo Minister banne ke liye bhi ayogya hoga.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Bahut badhiya! Union aur State ke minimum-maximum wala trap tumne pakad liya. Ab Council of Ministers ki teen categories dekhte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab ek zaroori concept - kya sabhi Ministers ki power ek jaisi hoti hai? Jawab hai - Nahi! Council of Ministers ek 'generic' (samuchit) term hai jisme teen alag-alag ranks (categories) hoti hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Teen category? Matlab Minister banne ke baad bhi kuch high-level aur kuch low-level hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Sabse upar hai Cabinet Minister - ye seniormost hote hain, important ministries (jaise Defence, Home, Finance) sambhalte hain aur Cabinet meetings mein regular hissa lete hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to Cabinet Minister sabse powerful hue. Baaki do category kaunsi hain sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Doosri category hai - Minister of State (राज्य मंत्री). Ismein bhi do sub-types hote hain - pehla 'Independent Charge' wale, jo apne dam par kisi mantralaya ka poora zimma sambhalte hain, bina kisi Cabinet Minister ke under kaam kiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab Minister of State bhi kabhi-kabhi poore department ka boss ho sakta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Doosra sub-type hai - Minister of State jo kisi Cabinet Minister ke under attached hote hain, aur unke department ke ek particular hisse ki jimmedari sambhalte hain, jaise 'MoS Finance' jo Finance Minister ke under kaam karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to ek Minister of State independent bhi ho sakta hai aur kisi ke under attached bhi - ye dono type hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Teesri aur sabse junior category hai - Deputy Minister. Ye kisi bhi mantralaya ka independent charge nahi rakhte, balki Cabinet Minister ya Minister of State ki madad karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye teeno mein kya important cheez yaad rakhni hai exam ke liye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yaad rakho - Cabinet Minister > Minister of State (Independent Charge) > Minister of State (attached) > Deputy Minister. Aur ek zaroori baat - salary/allowances ke maamle mein sabhi Ministers barabar hote hain, chahe wo kisi bhi category ke ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Ranking mein farak hai lekin salary sabki same? Ye to interesting fact hai, note karta hoon!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ek aur category jo bahut kam use hoti hai lekin exam mein poochhi jaa sakti hai - Parliamentary Secretary. Ye teeno wali category se bhi neeche aata hai aur Cabinet ka sadasya nahi hota - ye sirf Minister ki Parliament ke kaam mein madad karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, ye to bahut kam sunte hain, aajkal use hota hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye system aajkal India mein kam prevalent hai, lekin conceptually Constitution isse exclude nahi karta. BPSC/UPSC mein isse Cabinet Minister se compare karne wale question aa sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, samajh gaya - ye theek waise hai jaise school mein Class Monitor bhi ho sakta hai, jo teacher ki madad karta hai but decision nahi leta!

guess_payload.question: In char categories mein sabse senior/powerful kaunsi category hai?
guess_payload.explanation: Cabinet Minister sabse senior category hai - ye important ministries handle karte hain aur regular Cabinet meetings mein hissa lete hain.

quiz_payload.question: Council of Ministers mein kaunsi teen mukhya category hoti hain?

options.text: Cabinet Minister, Minister of State, Deputy Minister

quiz_payload.explanation: Council of Ministers mein teen mukhya category hoti hain - Cabinet Minister, Minister of State (Independent ya Attached), aur Deputy Minister.

summary_payload.title: ⚡ Quick Officer Revision - Council of Ministers

revision_points.point: Article 74 - Rashtrapati ko salah dene wali Council of Ministers, jiska mukhiya PM hai; salah court mein challenge nahi ho sakti (Article 74(2)); Article 75 - niyukti, shapath, 25/30 saal umar, koi fix term nahi (pleasure doctrine).

Article 75(1A) - Council ka maximum size Lok Sabha ki 15% (approx 81); koi minimum specify nahi (State mein 12 minimum hai - ye bada difference hai); Article 75(1B) - Anti-Defection disqualified vyakti Minister nahi ban sakta.

PM/Union Minister Parliament ke kisi bhi sadan (Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha) ka sadasya ho sakta hai; CM sirf State Legislature (Assembly/Council) ka - Rajya Sabha se CM nahi ban sakta; non-member ko 6 mahine mein sadasya banna zaroori (Article 75(5)).

Cabinet, Council of Ministers ka chhota senior sub-group hai (15-20 members), jo regular milta hai aur asli decisions leta hai; 'Cabinet' word original Constitution mein nahi tha, 44th Amendment (1978) ne Article 352(3) mein joda.

Article 75(3) - poori Council sirf Lok Sabha ke prati collectively uttardayi (Rajya Sabha ke prati nahi); Article 75(2) - har Minister individually Rashtrapati ki khushi tak; PM ke resign/death se poori Council bhang hoti hai, ek Minister ke resign se nahi.

Assertion (A): Union Council of Ministers ka size, State Council of Ministers ke size se sirf percentage formula ki wajah se alag nahi, balki minimum limit ke pravdhan mein bhi alag hai.
Reason (R): Article 75(1A) mein Union Council of Ministers ke liye sirf maximum 15% ki seema hai, koi minimum sankhya nahi di gayi, jabki Article 164(1A) mein State Council of Ministers ke liye maximum 15% ke saath-saath minimum 12 Ministers ka bhi pravdhan hai.
